doc.title: Stefon Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2020

title: Hauling vibraphones and playing whatever instrument is provided
summary: Harris recalls moving vibes as a young man in New York and now shows up and plays whatever instrument is at the venue.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Going back to the vibes for a minute I have this vision of you as a young man, you know before you could tell the venue what kind of vibes and marimba would be onstage for you, I was picturing yourself like going to a gig with the vibes, and the set-up of that is a bit of a chore, isn’t it?

Yes it is. I did it while I was young and in New York and then I said look if I ever have any level of success in this business I’m never moving one of these things again. So © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
generally when I travel I don’t bring a vibraphone or a marimba, whatever is available for me that day I’ll show up and play it.
